title: PGP Private Key
help: Your own OpenPGP key pair (identity) used for signing and decryption. A secret key embeds its public half, so this single connection holds both. Treat as sensitive — back the key material and passphrase with the registry / a secret vault, and keep it separate from external parties' public keys.

value.name: connectionName
value.helpTip: Unique name used to reference this key from operations.

value.name: privateKeyPath
value.helpTip: Secret key-ring location, e.g. resources:keys/alice-private.asc (project resource, recommended). Also env:NAME, inline ASCII-armored content, or a file path. Legacy registry (gov:/..., conf:/...) is also supported.

value.name: keyIdentifier
value.helpTip: Which key in the ring to sign with: a full fingerprint (40 hex, e.g. from 'gpg --fingerprint'), a 16-hex 64-bit Key ID (e.g. 0x3AA5C34371567BD2), or an exact user ID / e-mail (e.g. alice@example.com). Optional if the ring holds a single key; not used for decryption (matched from the message).

value.name: passphrase
value.helpTip: Passphrase protecting the secret key, used by the sign and decrypt operations. Provide via a secure expression such as $secret:pgp.passphrase rather than a hardcoded value. Leave blank for an unprotected key.
